text: Charity is patient, is kind: charity envieth not, dealeth not perversely; is not puffed up; is not ambitious, seeketh not her own, is not provoked to anger, thinketh no evil; rejoiceth not in iniquity, but rejoiceth with the truth; beareth all things, believeth all things, hopeth all things, endureth all things.
And now there remain faith, hope, and charity, these three: but the greatest of these is charity.
This is my commandment, that you love one another, as I have loved you.
God is charity: and he that abideth in charity, abideth in God, and God in him.
Let all your things be done in charity.
I can do all these things in him who strengtheneth me.
But they that hope in the Lord shall renew their strength, they shall take wings as eagles, they shall run and not be weary, they shall walk and not faint.
Take courage, and be strong. Fear not and be not dismayed: because the Lord thy God is with thee in all things whatsoever thou shalt go to.
Our God is our refuge and strength: a helper in troubles, which have found us exceedingly.
For God hath not given us the spirit of fear: but of power, and of love, and of sobriety.
It is better therefore that two should be together, than one: for they have the advantage of their society: if one fall he shall be supported by the other.
A threefold cord is not easily broken.
Iron sharpeneth iron, so a man sharpeneth the countenance of his friend.
He that is a friend loveth at all times: and a brother is proved in distress.
But above all these things have charity, which is the bond of perfection.
With all humility and mildness, with patience, supporting one another in charity.
Greater love than this no man hath, that a man lay down his life for his friends.
Rejoice with me, because I have found my sheep that was lost.
